listing.name: Dedicated Repair Equipment & Improvised Refinery | v0.0.1
listing.summary: 2 small mods that add their respective hullmods.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a built-in hullmod for the Salvage Rig that increases repair speed and reduces supply costs for a target ship while draining metals.

description: Adds a hullmod that aids in repairing a single other ship within the fleet. It increases repair speed but not CR recovery speed, and reduces recovery supply costs while active. The effect drains metals proportional to the target's recovery cost. This hullmod is built-in on the Salvage Rig and cannot be installed elsewhere.
